description: Unified engine for bloating, gas, rumbling, diarrhea, urgency, loose stool, and bowel discomfort after food.

rules: Do not diagnose IBS from a single food-related episode.
Do not use dysbiosis as a default explanation.
For dairy, first consider lactose or dairy sensitivity if symptoms are bloating, gas, rumbling, diarrhea, nausea.
For bloating plus bowel change recurring over time, consider IBS pattern only if pain is recurrent and related to bowel movements or stool changes.
For sudden diarrhea/vomiting with fever or sick contacts, elevate infectious gastroenteritis.
For isolated gas/bloating after heavy meals, keep overeating and fermentation patterns above pathology.
If blood in stool, black stool, dehydration, severe pain, persistent vomiting, fainting, or high fever are present, route to urgent evaluation.

red_flags: сильная или нарастающая боль в животе
симптомы не уменьшаются и явно ухудшаются

single_mild_episode.message: При единичном лёгком эпизоде срочные анализы обычно не нужны.

recommend_tests: клиническая оценка на непереносимость молочного по симптомам

causes.title: Переедание или слишком быстрый приём пищи
